summary: Tool that rewrites and tests your AI prompts to get better answers, as a web app, desktop app, Chrome extension or Docker image.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Prompt Optimizer helps you write better AI prompts. It improves a prompt in one click or over several rounds, lets you test and compare results across models side by side, and evaluates whether a prompt really got better.
sixtySeconds.problem: Writing good prompts is trial and error. Prompt Optimizer gives you a workspace to optimise, test, evaluate and save prompts with your own model keys.
whoFor: Teams building a library of tested prompts
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a free tool you can use online, on desktop, as a Chrome extension or self-hosted, with app data stored locally and requests sent straight to your provider.
requirements: An API key for a text model (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok and others) or a local model via the desktop app

overview: It supports system and user prompts, variable templates, multi-message context, arena comparisons between models, analysis and compare evaluations, image generation, favourites with version history, and MCP for apps like Claude Desktop.

Use the online version at prompt.always200.com (data stays in your browser), deploy your own on Vercel or Cloudflare, download the desktop app (.exe, .dmg or .AppImage) which can also reach local models like Ollama, install the Chrome extension, or run it with Docker.
For public deployments, set ACCESS_PASSWORD and don't preconfigure API keys, because VITE_* values are exposed in browser assets. The project is AGPL-3.0 licensed.
